env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
mkdir $WORK/bin

# An importer reads an exported const composite through tables and fresh copies.
cd m
logos build -o $WORK/bin/importcc$GOEXE ./app
exec $WORK/bin/importcc$GOEXE
cmp stdout want.txt
logos eject -o out
cd out
exec $GOROOT/bin/gofmt -l .
! stdout .
exists $UPROOT1272/bin/go
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go build ./...
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go run ./app
cmp stdout ../want.txt
cd ../..

# An unrelated field the importer cannot name leaves every other read of the composite working.
cd unnamed
logos build -o $WORK/bin/importunnamed$GOEXE ./app
exec $WORK/bin/importunnamed$GOEXE
cmp stdout want.txt
logos eject -o out
cd out
exec $GOROOT/bin/gofmt -l .
! stdout .
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go run ./app
cmp stdout ../want.txt
cd ../..

# A write into an imported const composite fails with the rule ID, whatever the member.
cd badwrite
! logos build ./...
stderr -count=9 '\[correctness::const_view_mutation\]'
cd ..

# A slice expression of an imported const composite is no way around the rule.
cd badslice
! logos build ./...
stderr -count=7 '\[correctness::const_view_mutation\]'
cd ..

# A readonly method of an imported const composite is callable; a mutating one fails with the rule ID.
cd methods
logos build -o $WORK/bin/importmeth$GOEXE ./app
exec $WORK/bin/importmeth$GOEXE
cmp stdout want.txt
! logos build -o $WORK/bin/badcall$GOEXE ./badcall
stderr -count=1 '\[correctness::const_view_mutation\]'
rm badcall
logos eject -o out
cd out
exec $GOROOT/bin/gofmt -l .
! stdout .
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go run ./app
cmp stdout ../want.txt
cd ..

# A range over a map of an imported composite visits sorted keys, for a variable index too.
cd ../rangeimp
logos build -o $WORK/bin/importrange$GOEXE ./app
exec $WORK/bin/importrange$GOEXE
cmp stdout want.txt
logos eject -o out
cd out
exec $GOROOT/bin/gofmt -l .
! stdout .
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go run ./app
cmp stdout ../want.txt
cd ..

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/ccimport

go 1.27

-- m/want.txt --
ok slice-leak-copy 1 99
ok slice-leak-reread 1
ok root-slice-leak-copy 1 99
ok root-slice-fresh 1
ok underscore-field-copy 1 99
ok underscore-field-fresh 1
ok qualified-value 1 2
ok promoted-range-sorted
ok index-range-sorted
ok array-leak-copy 1
ok whole-copy-isolated 1 2
-- m/lib/lib.lgo --
package lib

type Point struct{ X, Y int }

type S struct {
	M map[string]int
	L []int
	N int
}

type Box struct {
	M map[string]int
	N int
}

type U struct {
	My_map map[string]int
	N      int
}

type P struct {
	P map[string]Point
}

type Base struct {
	M map[string]int
}

type Outer struct {
	Base
	Tag string
}

type Arr struct {
	M map[string]int
	A [3]int
}

const C = S{M: map[string]int{"a": 1}, L: []int{1, 2, 3}, N: 7}

const Items = []Box{{M: map[string]int{"a": 1}, N: 1}, {M: map[string]int{"a": 1, "b": 2, "c": 3, "d": 4, "e": 5, "f": 6, "g": 7, "h": 8, "i": 9, "j": 10}, N: 2}}

const Under = U{My_map: map[string]int{"a": 1, "b": 2}, N: 7}

const Pts = P{P: map[string]Point{"o": {1, 2}}}

const O = Outer{Base: Base{M: map[string]int{"a": 1, "b": 2, "c": 3, "d": 4, "e": 5, "f": 6, "g": 7, "h": 8, "i": 9, "j": 10}}, Tag: "t"}

const A = Arr{M: map[string]int{"a": 1}, A: [3]int{1, 2, 3}}
-- m/app/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"os"

	"example.com/ccimport/lib"
)

var failed bool

func main() {
	s := lib.C.L
	s[0] = 99
	fmt.Println("ok slice-leak-copy", lib.C.L[0], s[0])
	fmt.Println("ok slice-leak-reread", lib.C.L[0])
	x := lib.Items
	x[0].N = 99
	fmt.Println("ok root-slice-leak-copy", lib.Items[0].N, x[0].N)
	y := lib.Items
	fmt.Println("ok root-slice-fresh", y[0].N)
	u := lib.Under
	u.My_map["a"] = 99
	fmt.Println("ok underscore-field-copy", lib.Under.My_map["a"] ?? -1, u.My_map["a"] ?? -1)
	v := lib.Under
	fmt.Println("ok underscore-field-fresh", v.My_map["a"] ?? -1)
	pt := lib.Pts.P["o"] ?? lib.Point{}
	fmt.Println("ok qualified-value", pt.X, pt.Y)
	for range 64 {
		got := ""
		for k := range lib.O.M {
			got += k
		}
		if got != "abcdefghij" {
			fmt.Println("FAIL promoted-range", got)
			failed = true
			break
		}
	}
	fmt.Println("ok promoted-range-sorted")
	for range 64 {
		got := ""
		for k := range lib.Items[0x1].M {
			got += k
		}
		if got != "abcdefghij" {
			fmt.Println("FAIL index-range", got)
			failed = true
			break
		}
	}
	fmt.Println("ok index-range-sorted")
	arr := lib.A.A
	arr[0] = 5
	fmt.Println("ok array-leak-copy", lib.A.A[0])
	w := lib.C
	w.M["a"] = 50
	z := lib.C
	fmt.Println("ok whole-copy-isolated", z.M["a"] ?? -1, len(z.L)-1)
	if failed {
		os.Exit(1)
	}
}
-- unnamed/go.mod --
module example.com/ccunnamed

go 1.27

-- unnamed/want.txt --
hidden 5 true
m 1
un 3
hidden-range g4;h5;
-- unnamed/lib/lib.lgo --
package lib

type hidden struct{ V int }

type Box struct {
	M map[string]int
	X map[string]hidden
	n map[string]int
}

const C = Box{M: map[string]int{"a": 1, "b": 2}, X: map[string]hidden{"h": {V: 5}, "g": {V: 4}}, n: map[string]int{"u": 3}}

func (b Box) Un(k string) int { return b.n[k] ?? -1 }
-- unnamed/app/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/ccunnamed/lib"
)

func main() {
	v, ok := lib.C.X["h"]
	fmt.Println("hidden", v.V, ok)
	fmt.Println("m", lib.C.M["a"] ?? -1)
	fmt.Println("un", lib.C.Un("u"))
	keys := ""
	for k, hv := range lib.C.X {
		keys += fmt.Sprint(k, hv.V, ";")
	}
	fmt.Println("hidden-range", keys)
}
-- badwrite/go.mod --
module example.com/ccbadwrite

go 1.27

-- badwrite/lib/lib.lgo --
package lib

type S struct {
	M map[string]int
	L []int
	N int
}

func (s *S) Set() { s.N = 1 }

const C = S{M: map[string]int{"a": 1}, L: []int{1, 2, 3}, N: 7}
-- badwrite/app/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/ccbadwrite/lib"
)

func main() {
	lib.C.L[0] = 9
	lib.C.N = 9
	lib.C.M["x"] = 1
	copy(lib.C.L, []int{7})
	clear(lib.C.L)
	_ = append(lib.C.L, 4)
	delete(lib.C.M, "a")
	lib.C.L[0]++
	lib.C.Set()
	fmt.Println(lib.C.N)
}
-- badslice/go.mod --
module example.com/ccbadslice

go 1.27

-- badslice/lib/lib.lgo --
package lib

type Item struct {
	M map[string]int
	N int
}

type S struct {
	M map[string]int
	L []int
	I []Item
}

const C = S{M: map[string]int{"a": 1}, L: []int{1, 2, 3}, I: []Item{{N: 1}, {N: 2}}}
-- badslice/app/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/ccbadslice/lib"
)

func main() {
	lib.C.L[:][0] = 5
	lib.C.I[1:][0].N++
	copy(lib.C.L[1:], []int{7})
	clear(lib.C.L[:1])
	_ = append(lib.C.L[:0], 4)
	copy(lib.C.I[:], []lib.Item{{N: 9}})
	clear(lib.C.I[:1])
	fmt.Println(lib.C.L)
}
-- methods/go.mod --
module example.com/ccmethods

go 1.27

-- methods/want.txt --
ok const-receiver 5
ok pointer-readonly 5
ok value-receiver 5
ok lookup 1
ok slice-const-receiver 6
ok slice-pointer-readonly 5
ok slice-lookup 2
ok slice-variable 6
-- methods/lib/lib.lgo --
package lib

type S struct {
	M map[string]int
	N int
}

func (r const *S) Get() int { return r.N }

func (s *S) Peek() int { return s.N }

func (s S) Val() int { return s.N }

func (r const *S) Lookup(k string) int { return r.M[k] ?? 0 }

func (s *S) Set() { s.N = 1 }

const C = S{M: map[string]int{"a": 1}, N: 5}

const Items = []S{{M: map[string]int{"a": 1}, N: 5}, {M: map[string]int{"b": 2}, N: 6}}
-- methods/app/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/ccmethods/lib"
)

func main() {
	fmt.Println("ok const-receiver", lib.C.Get())
	fmt.Println("ok pointer-readonly", lib.C.Peek())
	fmt.Println("ok value-receiver", lib.C.Val())
	fmt.Println("ok lookup", lib.C.Lookup("a"))
	i := 1
	fmt.Println("ok slice-const-receiver", lib.Items[1].Get())
	fmt.Println("ok slice-pointer-readonly", lib.Items[0].Peek())
	fmt.Println("ok slice-lookup", lib.Items[1].Lookup("b"))
	fmt.Println("ok slice-variable", lib.Items[i].Get())
}
-- methods/badcall/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/ccmethods/lib"
)

func main() {
	lib.C.Set()
	fmt.Println(lib.C.N)
}
-- rangeimp/go.mod --
module example.com/ccrangeimp

go 1.27

-- rangeimp/want.txt --
dynamic abcdefghij xyz
static abcdefghij
view xyz
-- rangeimp/lib/lib.lgo --
package lib

type Item struct {
	M map[string]int
	N int
}

const Items = []Item{{M: map[string]int{"j": 10, "b": 2, "h": 8, "a": 1, "e": 5, "c": 3, "i": 9, "d": 4, "g": 7, "f": 6}, N: 1}, {M: map[string]int{"z": 1, "y": 2, "x": 3}, N: 2}}
-- rangeimp/app/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/ccrangeimp/lib"
)

func keysOf(m const map[string]int) string {
	s := ""
	for k := range m {
		s += k
	}
	return s
}

func dynamic(i int) string {
	s := ""
	for k := range lib.Items[i].M {
		s += k
	}
	return s
}

func main() {
	static := ""
	for k := range lib.Items[0].M {
		static += k
	}
	fmt.Println("dynamic", dynamic(0), dynamic(1))
	fmt.Println("static", static)
	fmt.Println("view", keysOf(lib.Items[1].M))
}
